name: PowOS device agent (Devices app control channel)
purpose: this device's card, live status (power, screen on/off, locked, what keeps it busy) and actions (lock, screen off/on, guarded sleep, wake another device) for the Devices app on the other PowOS devices; HTTPS :3416 with its own pinned certificate, every status/action call authenticated by a per-device token given at pairing (code shown on this screen); mDNS _powos._tcp. docs/research/device-ecosystem.md
installedBy: lib/devices/deploy.sh powos@192.168.50.58 (systemd --user, user powos, linger on)
files: /var/home/powos/.local/state/powos/deviced (identity, TLS key, paired peers as token hashes; 0700)
autosleep: none needed: idle in accept(), a few MB

keep: /var/home/powos/.local/state/powos/deviced (delete it to forget every pairing and the device id)
